content.short: Remix is an open-source IDE for Ethereum development.
content.description: Remix is a comprehensive IDE for Ethereum development that supports multiple EVM-compatible languages, including Solidity, Vyper, and Cairo. It goes beyond its native environment by offering a VS Code extension, enabling flexible workflows across tools. Built for developers, Remix provides essential utilities such as a debugger that traces transactions, an analyzer for static checks, libraries of reusable components, and resolvers to manage dependencies and interfaces. These features streamline writing, testing, and deploying smart contracts across supported chains.
